name: Hawthorne Caballeros Alumni

name: Buccaneer Banner Brass

name: The Blue Way Middle School Honor Band
about: The Blue Way Middle School Honor Band is a Canton, Ohio youth ensemble appearing in Bluecoats-hosted DCI event lineups.

name: Rocky Mountain Brassworks
about: Rocky Mountain Brassworks is a Colorado ensemble appearing in DCI SoundSport update coverage and regional DCI event lineups.

name: Buccaneers Alumni
about: Reading Buccaneers Alumni Drum & Bugle Corps is a Reading, Pennsylvania ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble.

name: Alisal Union School District
about: Alisal Union School District Marching Band is a Salinas, California ensemble listed by SoundSport among its registered 2026 ensembles.

name: Rhythm IN BLUE
about: Rhythm IN BLUE is a North Canton, Ohio ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and appearing in DCI SoundSport event lineups.

name: Sparta Ignite
about: Sparta Ignite is a San Jose, California ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and appearing in DCI California event lineups.

name: Columbus Saints Jr. Flag Line
about: Columbus Saints Jr. Flag Line is an exhibition ensemble appearing in Bluecoats-hosted DCI event lineups alongside the Columbus Saints organization.

name: Mandarins Alumni
about: Mandarins Alumni Corps is a Sacramento Mandarins alumni ensemble scheduled as a special guest exhibition performer at the 2026 DCI Capital Classic.

name: BKXperience
about: BKXperience is Ascend Performing Arts' Blue Knights educational clinic and performance experience, including BKX Perform at Drums Along the Rockies.

name: Eastern Connecticut Symphony Orchestra
about: Eastern Connecticut Symphony Orchestra is a New London, Connecticut orchestra appearing as a special event performer rather than a competitive corps.

name: Connecticut Hurricanes
about: The Connecticut Hurricanes Drum & Bugle Corps is an all-age performance organization based in Seymour, Connecticut and competing in DCI All-Age Class.

name: Minnesota State University Clinic Band
about: Minnesota State University Clinic Band is a Mankato, Minnesota ensemble appearing as a pre-show clinic-band performer at The Kiwanis Thunder of Drums.

name: NC A&T Cold Steel Drumline
about: NC A&T Cold Steel Drumline is part of North Carolina A&T State University's Blue & Gold Marching Machine program and appears as a DCI event performer.

name: MBI
about: MBI, also known as Minnesota Brass, is an all-age drum and bugle corps based in St. Paul, Minnesota and recognized by DCI as an All-Age Class affiliate.

name: Phantom Regiment Alumni Corps
about: Phantom Regiment Alumni Corps is a Rockford, Illinois alumni ensemble assembling for a 70th-anniversary performance at the 2026 DCI World Championships.

name: Brig Juice Brass
about: Brig Juice Brass is a Syracuse, New York ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and by DCI in SoundSport Showcase Rochester materials.

name: The Blue Way
about: The Blue Way Summer Arts Camp is a North Canton, Ohio ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and appearing in Bluecoats-hosted DCI event lineups.

name: EN-CORPS by EN-RICH-MENT
about: EN-CORPS by EN-RICH-MENT is a Canton, Ohio ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and connected to the Bluecoats/EN-RICH-MENT local arts partnership.

name: The Marching Elite
about: The Marching Elite Foundation is a Baltimore youth music and arts organization founded in 2006; its competitive brass and hornline section performs at DCI SoundSport events.

name: Sacramento Freelancers Drum & Bugle Corps
about: Sacramento Freelancers Drum & Bugle Corps is listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and appears in the 2026 SoundSport International Music & Food Festival lineup.

name: Green Beret
about: Green Beret Marching Band is a competitive summer marching band in Rock County, Wisconsin, serving performers ages 10-21 and participating in MACBDA and DCI SoundSport-related activity.

name: Phoenix
about: PHOENIX Drum & Bugle Corps is a Silver City, New Mexico ensemble listed by SoundSport as a registered 2026 ensemble and in the 2026 SoundSport International Music & Food Festival lineup.

name: Calgary Round-Up Band
about: Calgary Round-Up Band is a Calgary, Alberta youth marching show band founded in 1956, providing music and dance training and live performance opportunities for junior high-age performers.

name: Calgary Stetson Show Band
about: Calgary Stetson Show Band is a Calgary, Alberta marching show band associated with Calgary Stampede youth performing-arts programs and listed in the corps directory as a SoundSport ensemble.

name: INpact & BANDtastic Band
about: INpact & BANDtastic Band represents DCI's INpact and BANDtastic honor-band programs, which bring middle-school musicians into DCI World Championships performances and educational activities.

name: Alisal Union School District All-Star Academy
about: Alisal Union School District All-Star Academy is a Salinas, California performing-arts ensemble appearing in DCI West lineups and aligned with SoundSport registered Alisal Union School District ensembles.

name: Apollo Marching Theatre
about: Apollo Marching Theatre is Alabama's DCI SoundSport team, an all-ages marching ensemble with 2026 performances including DCI Northern Alabama, DCI Birmingham, and the SoundSport International Music & Food Festival.

name: Spark
about: Spark is a DCI SoundSport ensemble based in Dover, New Jersey. Founded in 2025 under the Core Music and the Arts umbrella, Spark performs as a SoundSport-class group and invites members through its 2026 interest group.

name: City Sound
about: City Sound was a former southern California Open Class corps based in the Los Angeles area. DCI reported that the corps last competed on the DCI Tour in 2014 and rebooted in 2018 under the name Vessel Drum and Bugle Corps.

name: U.S. Marine Drum & Bugle Corps
about: "The Commandant's Own," the United States Marine Drum & Bugle Corps, is the Marine Corps' active-duty drum and bugle corps stationed at Marine Barracks Washington, D.C., and performs ceremonial and public events across the country.

name: Conquest Drum & Bugle Corps
about: Based in Geneseo, Illinois, Conquest Drum & Bugle Corps is the only SoundSport team in the Illinois/Iowa region. The corps' mission is to mold young people into responsible citizens and future leaders through dynamic music performance.

name: Taipei Yuehfu
about: Taipei Yuehfu is a junior drum corps and marching arts group from Taipei, Taiwan. Founded in 1996, the corps represented Taiwan in DCI International Class competition and won the 2005 Division III Prelims before returning to DCI in 2013.

name: Cadets 2
about: Cadets2 was an all-age corps from Allentown, Pennsylvania, formed in 2011 as an extension of The Cadets and Youth Education in the Arts. The corps won its first DCA championship in 2016 and competed through the 2018 season in DCX archives.

name: Apogee
about: Proudly representing the greater Pittsburgh area, Latrobe Music Center made its debut at the DCI World Championships and the SoundSport International Music & Food Festival in 2024, where the group earned a Silver rating for its performance.

name: Mercedes Marching Band
about: Mercedes Marching Band is a marching ensemble from Mercedes Norte in Heredia, Costa Rica. Part of Costa Rica's growing marching-arts community, the group represents the country on the international stage as a Drum Corps International entry.

name: Eruption
about: Eruption Drum & Bugle Corps was an Open Class corps based in Gig Harbor, Washington. The current DCI profile lists Gig Harbor contact information; historical business records list the organization as closed and preserve the former website domain.

name: Gita Surosowan Banten
about: Marching Band Gita Surosowan Banten is a marching band from Banten, Indonesia. The group represented Banten and Indonesia internationally, including a 2015 trip to compete during DCI World Championships week in the United States and later WAMSB competition appearances.

name: Racine Scouts
about: The Racine Scouts Drum and Bugle Corps began as an activity of Boy Scout Troop 15 in Racine, Wisconsin in October 1927. The corps was long associated with Scouting and youth music education, and later competed in DCI Open Class before ceasing DCI competition after 2016.

name: Chops
about: Chops Inc. is a Minneapolis-based nonprofit music and performing arts organization. In addition to its all-age drum corps, the organization supports parade units, indoor percussion, steel-drum bands, after-school drumlines, summer camps, and other music education programs.

name: Beijing 57 High School
about: Beijing No. 57 High School competed in DCI's 2025 International Class as one of two marching bands from Beijing, China. CGTN reported that Beijing No. 57 High School brought traditional Chinese melodies to the 2025 DCI Open in Indiana, blending them with modern marching arrangements.

name: Eclipse
about: Eclipse is a SoundSport drum corps based in Indianapolis, Indiana, sponsored by the National Sport and Performing Arts Federation (NSPAF). The group provides young musicians with competitive performance opportunities and professional training in a collaborative, supportive environment.

name: Alliance
about: Alliance was an all-age drum and bugle corps based in Atlanta, Georgia. DCX reports that the corps was formed in 2004 by Terry Reilley, Shirley Smith, and Andy Ritchie, with the intent to further music education while providing performers of all ages an affordable drum corps experience.

name: Coastal Surge
about: Coastal Surge was an Open Class drum and bugle corps based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. DCI approved the corps for the 2014 tour after 2013 exhibition performances, and described the organization as focused on instruction, performance objectives, and educational experience for its members.

name: Thunder
about: Thunder began as Spokane Thunder after the Spokane Drum Corps Association formed in 2004. The corps competed in DCI Division III/Open Class, became Thunder Drum and Bugle Corps as its reach grew beyond Spokane, and stopped fielding a corps after the 2017 season due to insufficient community support.

name: IMPACT Drum & Bugle Corps
about: IMPACT is a Central Florida drum and bugle corps that debuted in 2012 at the Drum Corps Associates World Championships and joined DCI SoundSport in 2016. The group operates year-round, performing at conventions, parades, high school band shows, and other engagements with members ranging from teens to older adults.

name: Impact
about: IMPACT is a Central Florida drum and bugle corps that debuted in 2012 at the Drum Corps Associates World Championships and joined DCI SoundSport in 2016. The group operates year-round, performing at conventions, parades, high school band shows, and other engagements with members ranging from teens to older adults.

name: Chien Kuo
about: Taipei Chien-Kuo High School Marching Band dates its drum corps origins to 1960, transitioned to standard marching instrumentation in 1982, added color guard in 1992, and is described by the Taiwan Marching Band Association as a leading marching ensemble in Taiwan with international performance and competition experience.

name: SoCal Dream
about: SoCal Dream, originally called the SoCal Dream Machine, was an all-age/senior drum corps that formed in Southern California in 2001 for performers no longer eligible for junior corps. The corps became independent under the Dream Association of California and competed in DCA/West Coast senior corps events through the early 2010s.

name: Sound of Sun Prairie
about: The Sound of Sun Prairie is a voluntary marching ensemble for students in grades 8–12, combining winds, percussion, and color guard. Affiliated with the Sun Prairie Band Boosters in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin, the group develops leadership and musical artistry while competing in DCI SoundSport and events such as the WAMSB World Championships.

name: Southern Knights
about: Formed in 2015, Southern Knights is an all-age drum corps from Alabama. The corps' 2017 summer season marked its first season performing as part of Drum Corps International's All-Age division, and the organization emphasizes member development through teamwork, self-discipline, preparedness, accountability, critical thinking, and leadership.

name: Southern Knights
about: Formed in 2015, Southern Knights is an all-age drum corps from Alabama. The corps' 2017 summer season marked its first season performing as part of Drum Corps International's All-Age division, and the organization emphasizes member development through teamwork, self-discipline, preparedness, accountability, critical thinking, and leadership.

name: Erie Thunderbirds
about: The Erie Thunderbirds Drum & Bugle Corps traces its roots to a corps founded in Meadville, Pennsylvania in 1956, taking its current form when the Thunderbirds merged with the Shoreliners in 1968. After going inactive in 1984, the corps was revived by alumni and today competes as an all-age corps in DCA and DCI All-Age events out of Erie, Pennsylvania.

name: Patria
about: Patria Drum & Bugle Corps is a Guatemala-based ensemble connected with Colegio Evangelico La Patria Occidente. The official school page describes the corps as including drum line, brass line, front ensemble, and color guard sections; it began as a banda de guerra in 1950, became a banda latina in 1990, and in 2003 became the country's first marching band.

name: High School Affiliated to BIT
about: The High School Affiliated to Beijing Institute of Technology Marching Band represents the Beijing public school affiliated with Beijing Institute of Technology. Marching China describes the school as having founded Beijing's first student Jinfan marching band in 1991, with a team ethos centered on unity, care, cooperation, trust, and a shared ensemble sound.

name: Kilties
about: Founded in 1934 in Racine, Wisconsin, the Kilties Drum & Bugle Corps is one of the activity's oldest organizations, recognizable for its tartan-clad Scottish identity. A successful junior corps through the 1950s and '60s, it disbanded in 1982 and reformed as an all-age corps in 1992, performing in competitions, parades, concerts, and exhibitions across the country.

name: Steel City Ambassadors
about: Originally founded in 1980, the Steel City Ambassadors are a self-supporting all-age, drum and bugle corps representing the Pittsburgh area. In 2025, the corps returns to the field in competition for the first time in the last 10 years. The Steel City Ambassadors are currently recognized as an All-Age Class Candidate, evaluating to join DCI's All-Age Class in the future.

name: Glassmen
about: The Glassmen Drum & Bugle Corps was a World Class corps from Toledo, Ohio — a nod to the city's heritage as the "Glass Capital of the World." Founded in 1961 as the Maumee Suns and renamed the Glassmen in 1971, the corps became a sixteen-time DCI World Championship Finalist. Mounting debt forced it inactive after the 2012 season, and it was dissolved in bankruptcy in 2014.

name: North Star
about: North Star is an all-age alumni group formed in 2015.  The group pays homage to the entertaining North Shore, Massachusetts drum corps that existed between 1976 and 1982 and was a DCI finalist from 1978 through 1980.  The alumni corps, which first performed at the 2015 Plymouth Hometown Thanksgiving Celebration, plays a variety of selections from the former corps’ audience-centric shows.

name: Blue Saints
about: Founded in 1952 in Sudbury, Ontario, the Blue Saints are Canada's oldest drum and bugle corps and the oldest surviving competitive junior corps in the country. The corps competed strictly in Canada until 2002, when it committed to the DCI tour, reaching the Open Class finals with a 15th-place finish in 2011. Since 2010 the Blue Saints have been the only active competitive junior drum and bugle corps in Ontario.

name: Teal Sound
about: Teal Sound was a drum and bugle corps from Jacksonville, Florida. After an early-1980s false start, founders Michael Butler and Danny Clark relaunched the corps for its official 1998 debut, aided by a grant from the Jacksonville Jaguars. Competing largely in Division II/III and Open Class, it was promoted to World Class in 2010 — the only World Class corps in Florida at the time — before going inactive in 2012.

name: Gems
about: Founded in 2022 and having performed in their inaugural season as a Drum Corps International SoundSport team in 2023, Gems Drum and Bugle Corps proudly represents the Treasure Valley. The Idaho organization's goal is to provide youth with performing arts programs that will help make them well rounded people in life and their musical pursuits. Gems' 2025 membership is made up of more than 80 performers representing seven different states.

name: Northern Lights Drum & Bugle Corps
about: Marking its inaugural season in 2023, Northern Lights achieved a Gold rating at the SoundSport International Music & Food Festival as part of DCI World Championships Week in Indianapolis. The corps' mission is to provide an affordable and accessible marching arts experience to all those who seek it in the Midwest. In the corps' second year of a three-year evaluation process, Northern Lights is currently recognized as an All-Age Class Affiliate.

name: Sky Ryders
about: The Sky Ryders Performing Arts Foundation came into existence in 2023 to bring its namesake back to Kansas. The Sky Ryders were regular DCI finalists in the 1980s and were well known for their popular repertoire, powerful brass lines and athletic color guards. With a string of successful educational clinics, a large group of volunteer alumni, and the support of the Hutchinson community, the Sky Ryders returned to the field in 2024 as part of DCI's SoundSport program.

name: Minnesota Brass
about: Founded as an American Legion corps in 1946, MBI has earned a number of accolades throughout its history. The group was a Drum Corps Associates (DCA) medalist from 2008-2016, and won the DCA championship title in 2011. In 2022, the corps was named "Best of Show" at the 2022 SoundSport International Music & Food Festival as part of DCI World Championships Week in Indianapolis. In the second year of a three-year evaluation process, MBI is currently recognized as an All-Age Class Affiliate.

name: Crusaders Senior Drum & Bugle Corps
about: Twin brothers Neil and Terry Connolly, alums of the Boston Crusaders, started the Crusaders Senior in 1991 as an opportunity to renew old friendships and maintain the traditions of their beloved junior corps.  Today, membership in the Crusaders Senior is not limited to alumni, and the corps attracts performers from a variety of other corps and bands.  Since its startup, the group has established its own identity as a parade and exhibition group and is one of the only corps to appear in every Drum Corps Associates Alumni Spectacular event since 1998.
